text:
ellie (partnerships): Hey team — ACME SI is targeting a joint marketplace listing + press announcement the week of Apr 12. Need a quick security packaging/runbook check.
raj (security): Thanks — what do we need in the package? SOC2, pen test summary, questionnaire answers, sample redacted artifacts?
ellie (partnerships): Correct. Also partner wants a single ZIP for the partner portal and a separate public-facing ZIP for marketplace listing (no sensitive bits).
sam (infra): For the portal bundle we can include full scan PDFs and the raw pen test result CSV, but public bundle must have only attestation summary + redacted screenshots.
marta (acme-si): ACME can provide their SOC2 Type II PDF by EOD Fri. They asked if we can host the portal bundle behind presigned links for 30 days.
raj (security): Presigned links ok. Security asks: presign must be restricted to ACME SSO group and expiring at 30d max. Also, we need an SHA256 manifest for every artifact.
ellie (partnerships): Noted. Who does artifact redaction?
marta (acme-si): We can do first pass of redaction, but we need Redwood to scrub any Redwood customer PII and internal IP.
raj (security): Let's be explicit: partner redacts partner-customer PII; Redwood redacts any third-party customer data + internal IP. I'll own the Redwood redaction pass.
nora (legal): Add a short attestation text file for the public bundle: "No customer PII included; redaction performed by both parties." I'll send a template.
ellie (partnerships): Great. Two timelines: item cutoff for press is Tue Apr 7; portal bundle can land Apr 9. Go/no-go decision Tue 7pm UTC.
sam (infra): Need to schedule an internal staging upload slot for the portal ZIP — requesting 1 hr window Apr 9 03:00-04:00 UTC to run presign and smoke tests. Can we confirm?
marta (acme-si): That works for ACME. We'll push partner artifacts to the shared secure S3 path earlier that day.
raj (security): Pen test: ACME's third-party pen test is scheduled Mar 29-31. They offered a pen summary doc after remediation verification on Apr 5. We need that before public bundle.
ellie (partnerships): So dependency chain: pen summary (Apr 5) -> Redwood redaction (Apr 6) -> public bundle prep (Apr 7) -> press go/no-go (Apr 7 19:00 UTC).
raj (security): I'll run a quick compliance checklist once I have the pen summary: items I check are CVE high/critical count, remediation evidence, scope alignment with marketplace offer, and export-controlled data flags.
marta (acme-si): FYI ACME SI expects us to call out the exact model variants that will be allowed in the listing (they want names + versions). We should include an allowed-models.txt in both bundles.
sam (infra): Good call. I'll generate allowed-models.txt from the release tag once product team locks it. Please ping when tag is final.
nora (legal): Also confirm no contractual NDA redactions are required for the public bundle. If ACME requires additional redactions beyond customer PII, we need that flagged now.
ellie (partnerships): Action items: @marta — upload ACME SOC2 + pen artifacts to secure S3 by Apr 5. @raj — Redwood redaction pass Apr 6. @sam — create presigned links & allowed-models.txt Apr 9 and run smoke window. @nora — send attestation template today. I'll coordinate press copy and the go/no-go calendar invite.
pressbot: Reminder set: "Marketplace joint listing go/no-go" on 2026-04-07 19:00 UTC. Invitees: ellie, raj, sam, nora, marta.
raj (security): Quick Q: Do we want a separate "evidence index" JSON listing artifact filenames + SHA256 + owner? Makes audits easier.
ellie (partnerships): Yes please — single JSON in portal bundle.
sam (infra): I'll produce evidence-index.json during staging and include presigned URLs for each file (expiring 30 days). URL list will be replaced with internal-only URLs in the public bundle.
marta (acme-si): ACME can sign the evidence-index.json with a PGP key if helpful. We can provide key id in the manifest.
raj (security): If ACME signs, add signature verification step to our ingress pipeline. I'll coordinate with infra.
ellie (partnerships): One final ask — press wants a 2-line security blurb for the announcement: something like "Redwood and ACME SI validated security posture: SOC2 Type II and third-party penetration testing completed." Draft it and I'll share with ACME communications.
nora (legal): Keep language high level, no claim of certification beyond SOC2 documentation. I'll review wording.
ellie (partnerships): OK — I'll draft and tag team. Anything else?
marta (acme-si): Please confirm who will be the public contact for security questions post-announcement. ACME suggested raj + acme-security@acme.example.
raj (security): Fine by me. I'll reply-only from the Redwood side; ACME can handle incoming partner questions.
ellie (partnerships): Cool. I'll circulate a one-pager and checklist tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
